assumptions: Archive members and target-project paths may be malformed, hostile, or already owned by the project.
validations: Validate archive membership, manifest digests, destination confinement, and collisions before any project write.
trust_boundaries.trust_ceases_at: Validated bytes cease to be discipline-owned after conservative installation transfers them to the target project.

data_classes.retention: Corpus bytes remain versioned; target-project bytes are read only for one install, check, or removal operation.
data_classes.redaction: Known credential fingerprints and machine-specific identifiers block release; review-shaped credential assignments remain explicit findings rather than copied silently.

sensitive_data_absence: The application does not intentionally accept credentials, personal data, or classified content; release scanning treats their accidental presence as a defect to refuse.
